Who is Ena?

If has heard of it, declares the two of them to be friends, and she shares that people can collect the forest children leave behind. On the contrary, if denies hearing the rumor, claims to have heard it from a that told her to be nice to a to receive a bigger . Despite not knowing what an is, believes that bigger is always better. She wonders if the big forest kid ever leaves the .

During the , flees inside the , where she sits at the end of one of the with . She considers bringing Mr. Goat inside. At the end of the day, admits she is tired before she heads to sleep. watches as she sleeps in one of the .
